tagline: Building the first and only global Cellular Broadband network in space accessible directly by everyday smartphones
hero_kpi_rationale: ASTS is positioned on a unique asset: access to critical satellite frequency bands essential for its business model of cellular connectivity from space.

kpis.name: Acquired satellite spectrum
kpis.explanation: Amount of satellite spectrum the company has secured for its operations.
kpis.description: The company has acquired usage rights for 45 MHz of mid-band spectrum in the United States and Canada through an agreement with Ligado, and an additional 60 MHz through the acquisition of an entity holding global priority S-Band rights.
kpis.signal: Secured a key asset for network deployment.

kpis.name: Mobile Network Operator partnerships
kpis.explanation: Number of mobile network operator partners for service distribution.
kpis.description: The company has established partnerships with over 50 mobile operators, representing nearly 3 billion subscribers worldwide.
kpis.signal: Extensive potential distribution network for the service.

kpis.name: Patent portfolio
kpis.explanation: Number of patents and patent applications owned by the company.
kpis.description: The intellectual property portfolio includes approximately 3,850 patent applications and officially granted or allowed patents worldwide, covering 38 patent families.
kpis.signal: Protection of key intellectual property for the technology.

kpis.name: Global footprint (facilities)
kpis.explanation: Total area of the company's facilities worldwide.
kpis.description: The company has a global footprint of approximately 450,000 square feet, including engineering and development centers in the United States, India, Scotland, Spain, and Israel.
kpis.signal: Physical infrastructure for development and operations.

kpis.name: Block 2 satellite antenna
kpis.explanation: Size of the phased-array network antenna deployed on next-generation satellites.
kpis.description: Block 2 BB satellites feature a phased array of approximately 2,400 square feet, more than three times larger than Block 1 satellites, designed for up to 10 times higher bandwidth capacity.
kpis.signal: Significantly enhanced antenna capacity for the service.

kpis.name: Block 2 satellite throughput
kpis.explanation: Expected throughput capacity per beam for Block 2 satellites.
kpis.description: With the introduction of the AST5000 ASIC chip, Block 2 BB satellites are expected to achieve a throughput capacity of 40 MHz per beam, supporting peak data rates of 120 Mbps.
kpis.signal: Major increase in data transmission capacity.

risks.title: High debt
risks.score_rationale: The company issued convertible notes totaling $1.075 billion in February 2026, which could weigh on its financial position.

risks.title: Macroeconomic risks
risks.score_rationale: Macroeconomic conditions, such as inflation and changes in fiscal and monetary policies, could negatively impact the company's operations.

risks.title: Technology dependence
risks.score_rationale: The company is highly dependent on technology, which could make it vulnerable to cybersecurity risks and technical failures.

risks.title: Geopolitical risks
risks.score_rationale: The company's operations in high-risk countries, such as Israel, could be affected by geopolitical conflicts.

risks.title: Credit risks
risks.score_rationale: The company has debt repayment obligations, which could strain its financial position if it is unable to meet them.

risks.title: Reputation risks
risks.score_rationale: The company could be affected by reputational issues if it fails to properly manage risks related to cybersecurity and technical failures.

ai_positioning.summary: The company ASTS does not explicitly mention artificial intelligence (AI) or machine learning in its 10-K report. The information provided focuses primarily on financial aspects, operations, and significant corporate events, with no reference to AI or its applications.
